author: UnicornSniper
body: Hai!  I wanted to know for those who make/uses skins for MC, which websites you use the most.  I mostly use Skindex or PlanetMinecraft, and then a few days ago started making my own on the Skindex website.  It is highly addictive making skins o_o'  However I saw that on Skindex, a lot of people's hard work are stolen and falsely claimed by others >:/  so I wanted to know which one you use, and which one has the best community for skin makers!  Kthxbai! (^_^)v
